scope: Recover complete-token profiling for the promoted resident, token-only, native-BF16 lm_head path without changing Numeric Parity V2.1 or default feature flags.

root_cause.coverage_hole: The saved 234 command buffers equal the default three batched expert matvec commits times 78 layers. Those batches already used the split ledger commit. The promoted resident attention, router and native-BF16 head used ordinary TokenCommandBuffer::commit_and_wait, so their submit/wait and GPU timestamps were absent from the ledger and their host wait wall accumulated in the 1.554 second unattributed remainder.
root_cause.static_identity: 234 = 3 * 78. This identifies the recorded subset; it is not a claim that the token had only 234 physical command buffers.
root_cause.head_contract_mismatch: The old cost-ledger and TPS harnesses required a full vocab logit vector. The promoted native-BF16 head returns an empty logits vector plus trace.sample_token and top-k diagnostics unless HAWKING_GLM_GPU_LM_HEAD_FULL_LOGITS=1. A profiler that kept the old assertion could not prove it measured the promoted token-only path.
root_cause.device_to_host_caveat: The saved 26.890 MB device-to-host mean cannot be assigned to the head alone. The default expert batching path also downloads intermediate matvec outputs. It is evidence of aggregate transfer volume, not proof of full-logit readback.

latency_reconciliation.reason: The 828 ms receipt reports a measured BF16-only value but does not preserve raw environment, resolved path flags, output mode, exact token/context, physical command graph or cache before/after state. The 2349.757 ms profiler receipt also lacks those fields and was produced by a harness whose full-logit assertion conflicts with the promoted token-only contract. The difference must not be labelled profiler overhead or a runtime regression from these artifacts alone.
latency_reconciliation.replacement_evidence: gravity_glm_cost_ledger now performs an exact-input same-process warmed A/B. Both arms use the same token-only resident flags and PhysicalTraceGuard observer, compare exact output/token/top-k/router/indexer decisions, compare physical command and encoder counts, compare per-token cache deltas, retain resident waits as secondary evidence, and separately report external observer delta and internal ledger bookkeeping time.

implementation.unattributed_rule: wall_us - sum(exclusive CPU buckets) remains an explicit line. No generic orchestration bucket exists.
implementation.command_buffer_recovery: Every TokenCommandBuffer commit records encode, submit, synchronize, dispatch, command-buffer and post-completion GPUStartTime/GPUEndTime data while a ledger token is active. Ledger-off still follows the historical single-CB flush path.
implementation.gpu_stage_attribution: Every dispatch is tagged from the nearest semantic scope. A homogeneous command buffer owns its real timestamp. A mixed command buffer keeps one whole real timestamp under mixed:<stage>+<stage> and reports exact dispatch composition; time is never allocated proportionally. Any dispatch-count deficit is converted to an explicit untagged component, and every command buffer reports whether semantic totals match the physical dispatch count.
implementation.sparse_expert_composition: The default sparse batch retains tensor names and tags each gate/up/down dispatch independently. An eight-routed-plus-one-shared batch therefore records routed_experts=8 and shared_experts=1 in each co-batched command buffer without splitting it.
implementation.head_composition: The native-BF16 head command buffer persists one final_head dispatch and two sampling dispatch tags, yielding mixed:final_head+sampling after the sampling scope ends and before commit.
implementation.physical_ab: PhysicalTraceGuard exposes read-only command_count and encoder_count snapshots. Both A/B arms run under equivalent physical observers and must have exact count equality. The profiled ledger command count must also equal its physical trace count.
implementation.cache_ab: The harness records absolute cache snapshots immediately before and after each decode. Absolute states are disclosed but are not claimed equal because the shared LRU advances between arms; resident-byte, entry, eviction and high-water deltas must be equal.
implementation.output_contract: Both profiler and TPS harnesses accept either promoted token plus top-k diagnostics or explicit full-vocab logits and record the actual mode. The recovery profiler requires token-only resident native-BF16 head flags and rejects TCB trace modes that change command structure.

source_modelled: floating-point operations with FMA counted as two

operation_accounting.theoretical_comparator: dense_equivalent_fp_operations is reported separately as 2 * rows * cols and is never substituted for executed work.
operation_accounting.limitations: Operation fields are not hardware counters. Packed address arithmetic, compiler transformations and data-dependent stable-sort comparison counts are excluded.

validation.live_gpu_measurement_reason: The full A/B/A/B gate measured a 14.656% MOP progress regression under the compiled Rust Metal candidate load, exceeding the 5% ceiling. No sustained sealed-model profiler or benchmark run was started.

exact A/B per-token resident-byte, entry, eviction and high-water deltas

live_acceptance_gate.bounded_command: HAWKING_GLM_GPU_RESIDENT_STATE=1 HAWKING_GLM_GPU_LM_HEAD=1 HAWKING_GLM_GPU_LM_HEAD_FULL_LOGITS=0 HAWKING_GLM_GPU_EXPERT_WAVE=0 HAWKING_TCB_TRACE=off HAWKING_COST_LEDGER=1 cargo run --release -p hawking-core --example gravity_glm_cost_ledger -- --context 4 --warmup 8 --ledger-tokens 16 --ab-context 1 --out HAWKING_PROFILER_RECOVERY_LIVE.json
live_acceptance_gate.measurement_policy: Run only after the paired contention evaluator authorizes a representative candidate load against the live MOP workers. The current full-duration receipt is a rejection, not authorization.

numeric_parity_and_default_behavior.numeric_parity_v2_1: HELD_BY_FOCUSED_TESTS; no arithmetic ordering or sampling decision was intentionally changed.
numeric_parity_and_default_behavior.default_flags: UNCHANGED; resident state, GPU lm_head, full-logit readback, expert wave and cost ledger retain their prior defaults.
numeric_parity_and_default_behavior.default_gpu_graph: Ledger instrumentation is inactive unless a ledger token is recording. On the promoted resident path, ledger-on records the same encoded command-buffer graph and reads GPU timestamps only after completion.
numeric_parity_and_default_behavior.tcb_trace: Must be off for the recovery A/B because split/prod trace modes can alter command-buffer structure.

remaining_gap: The code path and gates are implemented, but the >=95% live complete-token result and a measured 828-vs-profiled reconciliation remain unclaimed. The current full-duration contention receipt rejects sustained GPU work because it reduced live MOP progress by 14.656%; MOP remains untouched.
